visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged male host with glasses and short dark hair stands centrally. He is wearing a black button-up shirt and holds a small black remote. Behind him is a blurred green foliage background. The lighting is bright and even. Top and middle overlays show white and blue text. (2) The scene cuts to a still image or video of a dark, rocky cave interior. On the left, a massive, thick white spider web covers a large portion of the wall. On the right, a man in a red exploration jumpsuit and helmet stands looking at the web. (3) Back to the host in the studio. He is gesturing with both hands while explaining. Text overlays continue to change at the top and bottom. He clicks the remote frequently. The background remains the same green studio setting with professional lighting. (4) A scientific plot/chart appears as an overlay. It shows axes for delta 13C and delta 15N with various data points and text labels for different organisms like Tegenaria domestica. The host remains visible behind or beside the chart. (5) Video footage of the cave wall shows thousands of tiny white specks which are insects flying around in front of the thick web under a flashlight's beam. The man in the red suit is visible in the corner of some shots. (6) A close-up shot shows a brown and black spider resting on a white, funnel-shaped web. The texture of the web is highly detailed and looks like a thick fabric. The background of the cave is dark and out of focus.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 搜尋挺健康 秒懂諾貝爾生醫獎. [Slogan]: 史上最大蜘蛛巢穴的少子化危機. [Subtitle]: 是這個洞裡. (2) [Subtitle]: 超過 100 平方公尺的巨型蜘蛛網. (3) [Subtitle]: 裡面住了超過 11 萬隻蜘蛛. (4) [Subtitle]: 這不合理啊. (5) [Subtitle]: 這篇發表在《地下生物學》(Subterranean Biology) 期刊上的研究. (6) [Subtitle]: 由大型跨國團隊共同完成. (7) [Subtitle]: 而這個大巢穴是他們在阿爾巴尼亞和希臘邊界的一個. (8) [Subtitle]: 「硫磺洞穴」的牆上發現的. (9) [Subtitle]: 重點是科學家鑑定後發現 裡頭的住戶是「棚蛛」(Tegenaria domestica). (10) [Subtitle]: 還有「遊蕩始微蛛」(Prinerigone vagans) 這兩種. (11) [Subtitle]: 這超怪的 因為這兩種蜘蛛 尤其是那個棚蛛 是種居家蜘蛛. (12) [Subtitle]: 平常是獨行俠 絕對不群居. (13) [Subtitle]: 這是科學界第一次記錄到 他們竟然搞「群聚結網」(colonial web formation). (14) [Subtitle]: 產生了蜘蛛山的累 硬逼也逼不出的羈絆. (15) [Subtitle]: 而且這是一個沒有陽光 又充滿有毒硫化氫(H2S)的盜墓筆記標準場景. (16) [Subtitle]: 為了破解這個謎 科學家用了生態學的定番科技 「穩定同位素分析」. (17) [Subtitle]: 簡單說就是幫食物鏈「驗 DNA」.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear, high-energy male voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with professional broadcast clarity. The speech rate is quite fast and the tone is enthusiastic. In the background, a mid-tempo electronic pop track with a steady 4/4 beat and synthesizer pads plays at a low volume. (2) A short, airy whoosh sound effect marks a transition. The narrator continues his explanation about the spider web's massive size in the cave. The BGM maintains a steady tempo, keeping the energy high. The speaker's pitch has high variability, emphasizing scientific wonder. (3) The narration shifts to a more technical explanation of isotope analysis to track food sources. The BGM continues without interruption. There are no significant ambient noises, indicating a clean studio recording. Occasional ding sound effects are heard as new text information is visually introduced. (4) The BGM briefly ducks as a short audio clip of a male voice singing I am a rich man in English plays. This is a deliberate comedic insertion for about two seconds. The main narrator then resumes his fast-paced delivery with a playful tone. (5) The video concludes with a final sentence from the narrator summarizing the findings. This is followed by a short, high-pitched vocal sound effect used for comedic emphasis, and then the music quickly fades out into silence.
